newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rasa Industries up on business prospects.
newsitem.headline: Rasa Industries up on business prospects.

text.p: Shares in Rasa Industries Ltd climbed on Wednesday morning, lifted by hopes that the firm's involvement in the recycling of silicon wafers will be good for its business, brokers said.
As of 0041 GMT, shares in Rasa, which was a chemical producer before expanding into the electronics sector, were up 13 yen at 645.
"Semiconductor-related firms are popular now and the fact that the firm is involved in the wafer-recycling business is also a positive factor," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
